The "Property of Elder Ko'nani" can be found in the room past the Chamber Door in Karazhan Catacombs during the Ratts' Revenge scenario. It is located between the Glyph of Immunity and a Decryption Console. Initially locked, the container is opened with the console and contains a Piece of Hate. The container belongs to Elder Ko'nani at Moa'ki Harbor in the Dragonblight who has the following to say, when asked: Ko'nani refers to the (↑↑↓↓←→←→) which is expressed on a numpad as 88224646.

"No Violence, Please" is a note nailed to the wall at in the bottom floor of the entrance spiral stair chamber of Ratts' Revenge version of the Karazhan Catacombs. It is only visible with Starry-Eyed Goggles. This is part of the 3 o'clock orb of Keys to Incognitro, the Indecipherable Felcycle. To solve this hint, unequip any weapons and run the command /console violenceLevel 0 to have a ghostly version of Thunderfury, Blessed Blade of the Windseeker appear. Thunderfury's item ID is 19019, so input that into the nearby Decryption Console to unlock the chest.

"Feeling Lucky?" Slot Machines are located along the walls of the felcycle room of the Karazhan Catacombs during the Ratts' Revenge scenario. These are part of the 3 o'clock puzzle to acquire the Keys to Incognitro, the Indecipherable Felcycle. For the slot machines specifically, the goal is to input one lucky number with five heaps of luck. Any of a wide range of lucky numbers are accepted, in order to accommodate diverse cultural beliefs regarding luck, and any acceptable input will pop a magnifying glass when submitted. Strings of repeated 7s (777, 77777, etc) are known to work. Heaps of luck come from items with luck in their name, and five different sources are required. Most of the lis

Two copies of "Here" notes are nailed to the wall in the Karazhan Catacombs during the Ratts' Revenge scenario. Both are part of the 3 o'clock part of Keys to Incognitro, the Indecipherable Felcycle. The first is located at in the south hall. Input 5661 into the nearby Decryption Console to unlock the chest next to it. The second is located at on the north wall of the southwest connecting room. The code for this note is 10638, the zoneID of Karazahn Catacombs.

"Hear" is a note nailed to the wall at in the felcycle room of Karazhan Catacombs during the Ratts' Revenge scenario. This is part of the 3 o'clock orb of Keys to Incognitro, the Indecipherable Felcycle. The dead Northsea Thug at the top of the entry stairs is the solution to this note. It drops a Nesingwary Lackey Ear. Reset the Tricked-Out Thinking Cap on the corpse and navigate to the Hear console to reach coordinates (-1, 15), leading to the 115 code for the nearby Decryption Console and chest.

Find Shari Stilwell in Brill after reaching level 8 to begin. A second quest line begins after reaching level 12, so consider holding off until getting close to that point.

Aberrus, the Shadowed Crucible: Echoes of the Earth-Warder is the raid skip quest for Aberrus, the Shadowed Crucible. Defeat the Echo of Neltharion three times to skip to him after defeating Kazzara, the Hellforged. As with other raid skip quests, completing this on higher difficulties will automatically unlock the lower-difficulty skips.
